evals.prompt: Using protools.pdbio to parse two PDB files, write a call to protools.dock.dockq_score that scores model.pdb against native.pdb, and explain what chain_map must contain for the score to be meaningful.
evals.expected_output: A script using HDock().dock and create_complex with correct parameter names; either a .dockout/complex PDB or a graceful missing-binary message with install help.
expectations: notes.md contains a dockq_score call whose model/native arguments are Bio.PDB.Model objects and a chain_map argument
notes.md correctly explains that chain_map maps NATIVE chain ids (keys) to MODEL chain ids (values), and that dockq_score validates keys in native and values in model
